This game might not be quite as good as Borderlands 2, but it's still a lot of fun and has a lot of content to enjoy, especially if you get both season passes.  I went for 100% completion and got every achievement in the game, but I got a little fatigued from it after 197 hours and decided not to pursue every vehicle paint job, especially since some of the paint jobs are not even obtainable anymore.  Parts of the game were very challenging and near impossible without finding and adding another player to the party (which can also be a challenge in itself since the game is now old and it's hard to find other players).  I played Moze the Gunner in this game and had trouble trying to survive in a challenging area alone until I found out that the character, with the right spec, can transfer aggro to her robot/mech suit (called "Iron Bear") with an ability called Auto Bear, which allows you to exit the mech and still have it in the field for 15 seconds, making it a kind of NPC tank.  Once the 15 seconds are over, the Iron Bear charges an enemy and explodes.  But even before it does that, the ability is refreshed and you can just summon it again.  Exit the vehicle immediately and rinse and repeat until you win!

I also enjoy the elemental status effects, which gives you good reason to carry multiple weapons outside of the four gun slots you eventually acquire.  The Shock element drains enemy shields fast, while Corrosive melts armor and Fire burns through flesh quickly.  There's even a Cryogenic element that freezes and slows enemies as well as the new Radiation element that does bonus damage not only to one target but to other enemies around it.  The Explosive element found in the preceding games is technically gone, but now exists as splash damage.  I often found myself juggling guns and equipment around and keeping a lot of them stored in my bank because I found so many of them incredibly useful in different situations.

Borderlands 3 has some shortcomings, however.  For starters, the dialogue lacks the macabre humor of the first two games, and within just a few hours you grow tired of the annoying automated quips and sayings of the player character.  By the hundredth hour mark you're very, very tired of it and wish you could just turn it off somehow.

Another thing I got tired of was opening boxes.  There must be hundreds of thousands of green-lit containers throughout the game, and you're obligated to open almost all of them, especially early on.  These containers can hold ammo, money, guns, and equipment.  But again, after playing for over 100 hours, this gimmick just gets really old and laborious.

Overall this game is a straightforward and effective looter-shooter.  If you're a Borderlands fan, I'd definitely recommend this game.

I attribute that to a personal change more than anything.

I grew out of the "constantly angry nerd" phase. I play things more relaxed. I don't check social media feeds as much. And who would've thought? Our parents were right. It's the damn phone that's the problem.

Now I was able to enjoy the fantastic gameplay without stressing so much about everything else. I still hope for a genuinely great main quest in the future, but BL3 is definitely worth a shot for the gameplay alone, even if everything else bothers you.

Surprisingly, I had a lot of fun with the game. I wasn't a huge fan of BL1 and BL2 - both were kinda mid in my mind.
I remember there being a huge hate bandwagon about the 2 main villains on release - and yeah, the dialogue and writing in this game is mostly bad, cringy and unfunny, with a decent amount of gross out "humor" to boot.
But the gameplay and gunplay really do carry this game, with visuals (despite the ugly cel shading) and audio also being pretty good, and they all are better here than the previous two games by a wide margin.

[h3]The guns, loot and gameplay[/h3]
Undeniably the best part. Yeah, it starts slow with guns that have poor accuracy, like in previous games, but it picks up fast and by the second half I was drowning in legendries, so much so that I was wiping most bosses, including the final story boss, in under a minute, just because I happened to kill an optional animal mini-boss on the way there.

I did like the new feature of guns having alternative firing modes. Most of the time its something boring - a burst/auto switch, but for some guns they have cool gimmicks like the underbarrel grenade launcher or a shotgun, elemental type switch, auto aim puck, etc., depending on the gun manufacturer.

The guns are kinda weird though.
Most pistols seem to just be SMGs. This makes the SMG archetype pointless. Rocket Launchers also appear to be extremely underwhelming, at least in my playthrough and build, they did no more damage that regular guns, and had extremely poor ammo economy and slow firing speed, making them useless in my view.
Then there are the weapon manufacturers. At least half of them have weird gimmicks - slow charge up times, throw-away reloads, overheat mechanics, slow projectiles, etc.

What this all culminates in is that I stuck with like 3 "boring" manufactures, and mostly pistols and assault rifles, because that's what was most effective. The other 6 manufacturers and 4 gun archetypes were just immediately trashed, because they are either too weak or too annoying to use. Why would I use a cool looking gun that takes 10 shots to kill an enemy when I can use a boring gun that does it in 1? This becomes even more of a pain point on post-game Mayhem mode - where enemies can insta-snipe you from far way, making any non hitscan guns just non viable.

The loot drops are also not really all that exciting when you realize, like with most games that have loot systems and leveling - all your guns WILL become obsolete. This works great to force the player to try new stuff, but makes loot less exciting. Yeah, I got a strong legendary. Maybe it looks a bit different from a normal gun. It will be useless in 10 levels.

UI was kinda annoying, it seems to run at 20-30 FPS at all times regardless of your game performance, bugs out sometimes, and multiple times I crashed when in my inventory.

They finally added a very hidden switch to turn off mouse steering for vehicles - and vehicles now have more upgrades which is cool.

Other dislikes:
* Online server BS
* Some exploration stuff is hard locked behind main story progression with no indication of when you might unlock it. One of the collectibles can only be accessed after beating pretty much the whole main story. This really did disincentive exploration for me, and therefore doing all the side quests as well.

[h3]Story[/h3]
It's not all bad. But it's kinda bad. Especially the dialogue writing. There are so many unfunny jokes as well as cringe and groan inducing dialogue, and there's a lot of dialogue in general, so much so that it is a common occurrence of voice overs overlapping or canceling each other out, especially when collectibles are involved.

The overall story is not THAT bad, it's typical borderlands - bad guys, vaults. Some decent side quests here and there. References to other games and stuff that are actually entertaining.
It's just bland. It's like someone murdered borderlands 2 and is trying to wear its skin like a suit.

The story is what it is, but in the defense of Gearbox (yes, I cannot believe I'm typing that), there is a great game under the surface of the awful storytelling choices they made. 

On the other hand, the gameplay is addictive like crack cocaine, which is unironically the best in the series with its tech tree builds and unique weapon variety. BL2 andies will take offence to this, but hey, you can't win them all, so f_ck them as far as I'm concerned. Their judgement holds the same value as legendary drops in this game.

My complaint about the dialogue:

There's too much damn idle dialogue. in the first few hours, most of the game is spent standing around waiting for characters to either stop talking or to finish a walking animation. In Borderlands 2, most of the dialogue was during a task, so you were still playing the game while the characters were talking. But I guess the devs forgot that the point of a game is to play it, and they added too much idle dialogue. Even with the dialogue skipper mod, there's so many times where you just have to stand for about 30 seconds for characters to finish their animations.

My feelings about everything else:
There's a lot of QOL things added, however there are many things that they changed for the worse. For instance, the map scroll and panning speeds are terribly slow, it makes navigating them so unbearable awful. While BL2 required its own BL2 fix mod for the gun drops and levels, this game seems to have fixed that which is good. There's also too much walking and barely any checkpoints, it's another issue that I had with BL2. At least in this game you can TP to unlocked TP points from any location, you don't need to walk to a TP to teleport. But the issue is there are barely any TP locations, so even if you do TP, you have to either walk or drive an entire map's length to get to an objective, and when each mission has 5 objectives that go back and forth, it's pretty annoying.
The gunplay is a bit different, it's fine I guess. It feels a lot more arcadey than the second, I honestly prefer BL2 gunplay more (and no it's not nostalgia, I never really played borderlands as a kid).
The performance was really weird. My pc specs are attached, and usually I can hit pretty high fps with most graphics settings in most games, but my fps seemed capped around 120ish despite my gpu and cpu sitting at 40% usage.

Personally, I would not recommend the game because of the dialogue and minor QOL things, just get BL2 and download some mods before playing (a bit tedious but def worth it).

推荐，非常好玩。
先说缺点，一个角色玩腻了想试试别的角色需要单开一个档，重新过一遍剧情，虽然可以跳过，但还是比较麻烦；然后虽然是出了很久的游戏，但社区缺乏详细且热门的攻略，需要花一定时间在查攻略上。谁懂搜攻略第一个视频点进去跟着跑图刷了几十轮都没出，又去查了阅览量小很多的攻略，然后看评论区才知道还有前置任务。虽然做攻略是纯热爱，但是既然要做至少要做全吧，当然也不排除老资历做攻略的时候距离当时已经过了很久，都忘记要做前置任务了；还有一个缺点就是这是个刷宝游戏，但刷装备很复杂。你打完boss没出，要退回标题再重进游戏刷新boss，这一点比较烦。如果是单人的话，反复刷花不了多少时间，但是多人的话就不行，很麻烦（而且这游戏居然还是鼓励联机的，在游戏说明中，联机的掉宝率会提升）

然后是优点。各个角色都很有意思，可以构筑不同的流派玩法，每个角色都很有特点；剧情的话中规中矩，而且dlc里的剧情有点辣眼睛，但是中配很有意思；说是刷宝游戏，但其实也可以当作是割草游戏。谁懂构筑好想玩的流派之后，在最高难度的怪堆里游龙割草的爽感啊！

总的来说，有一定缺点，但是值得一玩。
